svg.aria-label: Overview: Says how much space you can free and which step to take first.; Folders: Every folder sorted by size, as a list, as tiles or as rings.; Large Files & Search: Finds big files and any name in seconds, without a new scan.; Clean Up: Removes caches, old logs and leftovers that macOS rebuilds anyway.; Duplicates: Spots files that exist twice and moves the extra copies to the Trash.; Unused Apps: Lists the apps you have not opened for months, with their size.; Menu bar: Shows the free space at a glance and warns you when it runs low.; Widget: Keeps the free space on your desktop or in Notification Center.; Report: Saves every category and the largest files as a text file.
